name: Sleeper Agent
description: Brown, green, pink and white noise for sleeping, with a sleep timer, gentle fade-in and fade-out, tone control, ocean swell and a blackout screen. It also carries five slow ambient synth themes — plain major through to dark minor — for meditation and relaxation rather than for sleeping through. Sound is generated privately in the browser.
note: Designed for overnight use on a phone. The ambient themes are optional and off by default.
